page.layout: One page of text, single column; a verse passage set indented within it; catchword at lower right. Top has a dark scan artifact (not printed).

main_text.p: & intra triennium utraque infula politi sunt. Majoricæ Rex ab ipsis in bello interfectus : Regina cum parvo filio Fisis triumphata : puer Christianus simul & Canonicus factus, postremo in patrium regnum remissus est. Ergo author nostrin anno erravit ac scribendum 1117. Extant Massilia in ede Victoris versus, quo Pisini eo in bello Balearico cæsos honoraverunt, quos non ob elegantiam (sunt enim, utea tempora ferebant, barbari) sed ut major huic narrationi lux, apponere visum :
main_text.l: Verbi incarnati de virgine mille pras-
Annis bis centum , bis septem commeratis,
Mane neci dantur : multi tamen his sociantur
Angelicæ turbæ cœlique locantur in urbe.
Terra destructa classis redit æquore desta,
Primum ope divina , simul & victrice carina,
O pia victorum bonitas, defuncta suorum rum

page.notes: Scan has a dark artifact across the top margin and a faint stamp at lower right; neither transcribed. Some verse lines are heavily set and uncertain (e.g. "pras-actis" is probably "pra-ctis"; "Fisis", "Pisini", "utea" as printed). Marginal marks at line ends are not text.
